_comment: SDXL Turbo — the DRAFT engine. 1–4 steps, CFG 1.0 (Turbo is distilled: classifier-free guidance is baked in, so a CFG above ~1 burns the image). Seconds per frame on MPS instead of minutes, which makes it the right tool for finding a composition. It CANNOT use the Flux house LoRA — different architecture — so drafts will not carry the IBRA look. Compose here, then re-run the same prompt through Flux for the final frame. The plugin patches: 6.text (positive), 7.text (negative), 5.width/height, 3.seed, 3.steps.
_licence: SDXL Turbo ships under Stability's non-commercial research licence — the same practical constraint as FLUX.1 [dev]. Switching engines does not buy you commercial rights.
_upscale: Generate NATIVE (Turbo 512, Flux 1024) then upscale to the canvas. Pushing a model past its training resolution is what duplicates subjects. The plugin patches 90.model_name and 92.width/height; if no upscale model is installed it rewires 9.images back to the VAEDecode.
